description: Fix review issues: timeline endpoint mismatch, serializer missing current_account, member removal authorization, 'me' account_id resolution, and N+1 in StatusPolicy.
steps: Fix frontend timeline endpoint: change expandOccmGroupTimeline and fillOccmGroupTimelineGaps in actions/timelines.js to use /api/v1/occm_groups/${id}/timeline instead of /statuses
Fix OccmGroupsController: add current_account: current_account to render options in show, create, update, and transfer actions
Fix MembersController#destroy: resolve 'me' to current_account.id, differentiate self-removal from moderation-removal with authorize @occm_group, :moderate? for non-self removals
Fix StatusPolicy#occm_group_post?: use record.occm_group_status.present? instead of OccmGroupStatus.exists? query
Fix StatusPolicy#viewable_for_occm_group?: use record.occm_group_status instead of OccmGroupStatus.find_by
acceptance_criteria: Serializer receives current_account in all single-group render calls
Member removal requires moderate? policy for removing others, allows self-removal without it
'me' param is resolved to current_account.id before service call
StatusPolicy uses preloaded association instead of N+1 queries
verification: Run: ruby -c on modified Ruby files to verify syntax
Run: npx tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript still compiles
findings: All 5 review fixes implemented successfully. Ruby files pass rubocop with no offenses. JavaScript passes eslint. Pre-commit hooks (rubocop, eslint, i18n:extract) all pass. Added occm_group_status to CACHEABLE_ASSOCIATIONS to ensure the preloaded association is available when StatusPolicy checks are performed on collections.
